newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy mixed, most corn offers down.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy mixed, most corn offers down.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean values were mixed and corn offers were mostly lower Tuesday, while wheat was unchanged in very slow dealings, exporters said.
Because U.S. wheat prices are not competitive with those in Australia or Europe, exports from the U.S. have been lackluster lately, wheat traders said.
Nearby corn FOB values were supported by recent Asian purchases of U.S. corn, one exporter said.
In U.S. export business Tuesday, various feed groups from Taiwan bought U.S. corn and soybeans, but no fresh wheat business surfaced, export sources said.
